text: Rearrange the letters of SKYE to make the things you open a lock with.
Rearrange the letters of BUTE, a Scottish island, to make a nickname for the London Underground.
A ferry to Lundy leaves at 9:15am and takes 2 hours 50 minutes. What time does it arrive?
A cliff lift carries 12 people a trip, and each round trip takes 4 minutes. How many people can it take up in an hour?
On a cliff there are 31 seabirds: puffins and gulls. There are 7 more gulls than puffins. How many puffins?
why: Take away the 7 extra gulls: 24 left, split evenly, so 12 puffins and 19 gulls.
